name: restart-countdown
description: Announce a restart in-game (e.g. 15/10/5/1 min), save, then restart
author: the-isle-dedicated-server

WARNINGS.description: Minutes before the restart at which to announce

MESSAGE.default: Server restart in {minutes} minute(s) - find a safe spot!

FINAL_MESSAGE.default: Restarting now - back in a few minutes.

usage: isle-server plugins run restart-countdown           # countdown from the largest WARNINGS value
isle-server plugins run restart-countdown run 5     # 5-minute countdown
Schedule it, e.g. cron:  0 6 * * *  isle-server plugins run restart-countdown
